cards.design_implication: If the study design relies on detection statistics, consider evaluating whether signal-to-noise ratio thresholds are appropriate or if alternative metrics are needed to avoid statistic-dependent bias.

cards.evidence_excerpt: Contrary to previous work, we cast our results in terms of the detection probability (DP), since the commonly adopted criterion based on a signal-to-noise ratio threshold is statistic-dependent and may result in misleading conclusions for the statistics adopted here.
limitations: This claim is derived solely from an abstract and reflects the authors' methodological choice and rationale.

cards.design_implication: If designing a similar observational study, ensure the simulation or sampling strategy covers the parameter space defined by current electromagnetic constraints to maintain unbiasedness.
does_not_establish: The specific parameter values or ranges used.
The accuracy or precision of the simulations themselves.
cards.evidence_excerpt: To address this issue, we analyse a broad set of simulations of the cosmological population of SBHBs that cover the entire parameter space allowed by current electromagnetic observations in an unbiased way.
limitations: The scope is limited to what is defined by 'current electromagnetic observations,' which is time-dependent.
The abstract does not detail the specific electromagnetic observations or parameter ranges included.
cards.statement: The analysis is restricted to a simulation-based framework that covers the entire parameter space allowed by current electromagnetic observations in an unbiased way.
